Class Shields

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Shields
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class Shields extends Tile
Represents a shield tile in the game, which can protect one of the four corners of the ship (North-East, South-East, South-West, North-West). The covered area rotates with the tile.
